transcript: Maintainer-authored offline artifact example for maker/scoped-agent. Independent checks run after application; no model behavior is measured.

files.content:
---
name: patch-notes
description: Draft local change notes from supplied repository evidence.
---

# Patch Notes

Activate for the exact phrase `draft patch notes` in a repository-change context.
A generic mention of notes does not activate this agent.

- CN: Create a note from the supplied diff.
- VR: Verify references against the supplied files.

Write only inside notes/. Ask for missing diff evidence; never invent changes.
Never publish or send messages. No external tools are available.
